notes.title: Celebrating One Year (Sort Of)
notes.content: [h1]We're Doing Another Discord Call![/h1][h3]Sunday, July 20 at [b]1:00 PM [u]Central Time[/u][/b] [url="https://discord.com/invite/WdQWyhcb2q"]https://discord.com/invite/WdQWyhcb2q[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/1e60f466645d61d3c63df0b770799f3d16204e32.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Testing animations from our original game idea: 3D Vampire Survivors + Slay The Spire. This was a month or two before pivoting to Smithy By Day.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]On July 1, we [i]internally[/i] celebrated one year of working on Smithy By Day. [/p][p][/p][p]It wasn't a celebration of Galaxy Bunny Games being formed, it wasn't a celebration of working on our first game, and it wasn't a celebration of SBD being developed. It was a celebration of us deciding to do a 2D blacksmithing shop manager where you gather resources during the day, and manage your shop at night.[/p][p][/p][p]And oh, how much that idea's changed.[/p][p][/p][p]We went back and forth on design and scope, we worked on a 2D game before switching to 3D, and most importantly, you smith during the day and gather resources at night![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this yearish of working on SBD, and 10~ months of development, I, Kevin "Fornari" Fornari, will be hosting another Discord call. I'll mainly be going over the trailer shot-by-shot, expanding on mechanics we teased and covering some you may have missed.[/p][p][/p][p]The call will be [b]Sunday, July 20 at 1:00 PM [u]CENTRAL TIME[/u][/b]. As always, anyone is free to hop in the call, or you can live message in the SBD Discord and I'll answer whatever questions y'all have.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to all friends, fans, community members and aspiring smithies. Stay hype![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/WdQWyhcb2q" style="button"]Smithy By Day Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/69ae719ce031b5b7b990e4f47e9d0e6dae535ce9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Introducing Smithy By Day's Lead Artist: Nautical Sorbet
notes.content: [p]Work going underappreciated, art going unseen; trying to spread joy through organizations that couldn't facilitate it. That is the origin story of Galaxy Bunny Games, and that is the origin story of [b][u][url="https://nauticalsorbet.com/"]Naia "Nautical Sorbet"[/url][/u][/b].[/p][p]"I felt like I wasn't being creative," Naia said. "I rarely got to make something that people were excited for."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/238132929b3172eeaa95664dd355ba783a577bc5.png"][/img][/p][p]Since she was a kid getting in trouble for drawing on walls, Nautical Sorbet dreamed of being an artist. After getting a degree in Art & Entertainment Technologies, she flexed those artistic aspirations through commissions and side projects, but mainly, worked on designing UIs for different companies over four years.[/p][p]During that time, the need to be an independent artist kept growing. After a test run of working for herself part-time during COVID, Naia eventually decided to quit her full-time job last year, devoting all her working hours to independent art.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/c66b4c8ab3d6c3a1efd118a68b75c5cc7cb73800.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u][url="https://nauticalsorbet.com/"]Visit her website here[/url][/u][/b][/p][p][/p][h1][b]"Maybe it was my hubris, maybe delusion."[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]"With the first brand, it took a year to get to 1,000 followers, and this second time around, I already knew the strategies. I got to 1,000 followers within three months instead. I was anticipating this time around it would be a little easier, and it was.[/p][p]I realized I am so much more motivated to work on personal projects, projects I am really close to the production of. With SBD, the harder I work, it will correlate to success of the game, and that doesn't happen with a company that you work for.[/p][p]I just feel so much more useful. I exist as a more useful individual now hahaha."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/ba58c63e17dcfc227e26e4482b5651e51f2c0888.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For Smithy By Day, Naia's particularly enjoyed designing UI, and even moreso, painting on textures. Her favorite part of 2D art is coloring, and that skill translates to painting on 3D textures.[/p][p]"I'm having fun learning the techniques behind the hand-painted style of 3D we're trying to go for. Similar to what Overwatch does with their textures, we want our environments to feel soft, easy on the eyes, yet whimsical."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/30ade975a25903eca346b73006e4330d9df89d9c.png"][/img][/p][p]However, since she's finished a draft 3D-model of the smithy building, Nautical Sorbet has been itching to start making furniture.[/p][p]"I love playing Minecraft and making houses. Plus decorating and designing the interiors, I'm really looking forward to that. In any game where you can build a base, I love that; that's so much fun to me."[/p][p]"For SBD, my hope and goal is to create an environment that really does feel like you're in a cozy forge. Where it feels like something new, but also familiar. And I hope players enjoy looking at it!"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/0060d20759e84ba20456d7a7ce07cac18abe5b95.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/WdQWyhcb2q" style="button"]Smithy By Day Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: We're Making A Great Video Game
notes.content:
[p]For the last eight years of my life, I feel that every major decision I’ve made, every argument I’ve had, and every success and failure I’ve enjoyed, all led me to one realization: I must make a great video game.[/p][p]It doesn’t feel like an aspiration or desire. It feels like an obvious duty.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/69ae719ce031b5b7b990e4f47e9d0e6dae535ce9.png"][/img][/p][p]Every article I’ve written, every person I’ve interviewed, every job I’ve had, every client, event and organization I’ve worked with, every tournament I’ve entered and every single person I’ve talked to about gaming has led me to only one conclusion: I must make a great game.[/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]WE must make a great game, and we will.[/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][p]Today, I, and one of my closest and oldest friends, Joseph “Jotapon” Garcia, are officially announcing our game studio Galaxy Bunny Games, and with that, our first game in development:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/71d2c3cccaa216ab7836c4124998f93c32c04e96.png"][/img][/p][p]Joseph’s taught me video editing and programming. He developed Free Range Musings, an online publication that allowed us to explore gaming and esports journalism. And now, I’m joining him again, this time to make a great game.[/p][p]Although I’ll be the face people see most, you must know Joseph is literally working five times harder than me. While I’m balancing game development with a full-time job, Joseph’s full time is Smithy By Day.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/acf8f640a5e3e17f09a7ccc213e649ad39d8d7f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]He’s working more than 40 hours a week developing SBD. It’s his sole obsession and focus.[/p][p]We’re going to push each other and make a great game.[/p][p]We may delay and stumble, we may cut our scope back, we may even scrap entire games before release; in fact, we’ve already scrapped one game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/1e60f466645d61d3c63df0b770799f3d16204e32.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Image of mechanics-testing from a scrapped game[/p][/*][/list][p]However, it is our promise that we’ll always communicate and try our best to respond. It is also our promise to only release games we want to play, games we’re proud of. And finally, it is our promise to see every game through until at least 1.0/ full release. We will never abandon any game.[/p][p]Even if a game isn’t successful, I still personally guarantee persevering to a 1.0 release. The only alternative is bankruptcy.[/p][p]There are no excuses, there are no exceptions, there are no other options.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Don’t just take our word - let us prove it[/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We believe in our vision, our game and ourselves. Allow us to show you everything.[/p][p]Ask us for screenshots and frequent updates and as much proof as you'd like. Don't give us your trust easily.[/p][p]Push us to communicate. Push us to interact with our community.[/p][p]Push us to be better and tell us when we’re failing you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/fa061719da3c476326c90cacbf02a0e092e9a1c3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, the most important part: I’d like to talk about Smithy By Day a bit.[/p][p]I’ll speak super broadly as we’re still testing mechanics and nothing’s nailed down yet. The plan is that you run a smithy during the day time and gather resources at night.[/p][p]Think Dave the Diver and doing caves in Stardew Valley.[/p][p]I specifically wanted to design around blacksmithing because there’re so few games that go even remotely in depth. Games that focus on smithing typically lean on recipes or time management.[/p][p]SBD will have those mechanics, but I also wanted to especially focus on the steps of making, let’s say a sword, and build several minigames around that.[/p][p]You start by heating up metal, then an anvil hammering minigame, quench sword, handle/ crossguard assembly minigame, sharpening minigame, maybe some alchemy and enchantment minigames, and maybe even a jewel-socketing minigame.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/eedb949fa6c8e456272f50f9a014d00d1ef7ebd0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Another mechanic I’d like to share, which Joseph’s currently working on, is how time will pass in the smithy. I really dislike stressing about clicking on workers immediately after they complete a task to min-max time usage.[/p][p]SBD will not require you to know terms like micro and APM. Instead, we’re thinking of making time pass in increments.[/p][p]As an example, the day could start at 8:00 AM; your character can walk around infinitely without time passing.[/p][p]You click the sharpening wheel and play a minigame which locks your movement for 30 minutes. You then essentially pass turn, the clock speeds up and stops at 8:30 AM, and now your character can once again walk freely.[/p][p]Finally, I’d also like to hint at one last feature: the story. All I’ll say is, if things go the way I hope, I think Attack on Titan fans will be very happy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650461/c8032276e26cbad720db5c6c22486a878141b321.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re ecstatic and obsessed with the path we’re going on. I can’t guarantee you’ll like Smithy By Day, but I know Joseph and I will love it.[/p][p]At the end of the day, I think that’s all any artist can promise. I also think that’s something we can and will deliver.[/p][p]I think, we’re going to make a great video game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Join Our Discord[/h3][p][/p][p]Stay informed on every minor update, share other games you like, talk to the devs and join an awesome gaming community![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/WdQWyhcb2q" style="button"]Smithy By Day Discord[/url][/p]
